business_process: Cooking, smoking, and chilling (cooking and chilling CCPs)
description: Run smokehouse cycles for smoked sausage, hams, and jerky; record core-probe temperatures; chill cooked product in the blast chill cooler and record stabilization
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Food safety: a cook or chill cycle without a trusted record means the product must be held and may be destroyed (9 CFR 417.3); a batch in the smokehouse is worth about $3,000 to $6,000; past one production day raw material for the next cooks starts to age
manual_workaround: Cycles finish on the smokehouse controller without the network; handheld thermometer readings and the controller display recorded on paper CCP forms; chilling checked with a calibrated handheld probe every 30 minutes on paper
dependent_third_parties: Smokehouse manufacturer (remote service); cold-chain monitoring vendor; records app vendor
dependent_people_or_facilities: Production Supervisor; production workers; smokehouse and blast chill cooler

business_process: Cold storage temperature control and monitoring
description: Keep coolers, the freezer, the blast chill cooler, the drying room, and the truck in range; alert on excursions; keep temperature records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Inventory in the coolers and freezer is worth about $25,000 to $40,000; an unnoticed excursion can make raw or cooked product unsafe; cooler temperatures are the monitoring record for the raw product ground plan
manual_workaround: Manual temperature log every hour with a calibrated thermometer; a person on site or on call overnight until alerts are restored
dependent_third_parties: Cold-chain monitoring vendor; internet provider; refrigeration contractor
dependent_people_or_facilities: Production Supervisor; Maintenance and Sanitation Technician; coolers and freezer; power

description: Grind, mix to formulation, stuff, and link fresh and smoked sausage
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Raw material shelf life and next-day orders; formulations (including cure for smoked products) must be right, so a stuffer HMI or recipe problem stops the line
manual_workaround: Printed formulation sheets signed by the Production Supervisor; stuffer run in manual mode where the HMI allows; delay fresh sausage one day
dependent_people_or_facilities: Production Supervisor; production workers; raw processing room

description: Vacuum package, print and apply labels with product name, ingredients and allergen statement, and lot code; check seals and labels
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A wrong label or missing allergen statement is misbranding and can force a recall with a 24-hour FSIS notice (9 CFR 418.2); finished product cannot ship unlabeled
manual_workaround: Pre-printed labels from the last approved batch with lot codes applied by hand; second-person check of every label run; hold product until labels are verified
dependent_systems: SYS-02 (packager and label printer); SYS-03 (labeling PC); SYS-12 (AI camera pilot)
dependent_third_parties: Packaging machine vendor (remote support and AI camera)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Production Supervisor; production workers; packaging room

business_process: Food safety records and pre-shipment review
description: SSOP pre-operational and operational records, HACCP monitoring, corrective actions, verification, and the pre-shipment record review; records available to FSIS
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Product may not ship until its records are reviewed (9 CFR 417.5(c)); records must be available to FSIS (417.5(f); 416.16(c)); records lost or altered make the HACCP system inadequate (417.6(d))
manual_workaround: Paper SSOP and HACCP forms kept in the downtime binder; pre-shipment review on paper signed and dated by the Production Supervisor or the owner; enter into the app after restore
dependent_systems: SYS-05; SYS-01 (cook log); SYS-04 (chilling log); SYS-08 (internet)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Production Supervisor; owner (backup reviewer); FSIS inspection program personnel

description: Take wholesale orders by phone and email; build the delivery route; invoice with lot numbers; collect payment
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $16,500 of wholesale deliveries a week; invoices with lot numbers are the trace record the recall procedure needs (9 CFR 418.3)
manual_workaround: Phone orders on paper; handwritten delivery tickets with lot numbers; invoice when restored
dependent_third_parties: Accounting service vendor; productivity suite vendor; internet provider

description: Sell packaged product at the front counter
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $1,100 a day; customers can return; the card terminal runs on its own cellular link
manual_workaround: Cash and a paper sales log; the provider-managed terminal works without the company network

description: Biweekly payroll; supplier orders for meat, casings, spices, and packaging; HR files; insurance
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly through the payroll service; meat suppliers take phone orders
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll through the payroll service; order by phone
dependent_third_parties: Payroll service; productivity suite vendor; MSP
